'''Otokwo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] doctor of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]] Otokwo was among the scientists the Republic brought down to the surface of the planet. Along with fellow scientists [[Prahmin]] and [[Cherush]] Otokwo was kidnapped by a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] operative working for [[Darth Marr]] and forced to assist [[Katha Niar]]'s team in stabilizing [[Makeb]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Otokwo appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion, added to the game with Update 2.0.
